spans.s: --the son of देवातिथि, and father of दिलीप. भा. IX. २२. ११.
--a mt. from which several rivers originate. M. ११४. २३-26.
(I)--a sage of the eighth मन्वन्तर। भा. VIII. १३. १५; Vi.

(II)--married शान्ता, the adopted daughter of रोमपाद. Superintended the इष्टि of दश- ratha to propitiate Indra and blessed दशरथ with issue.
1: भा. IX. २३. 8-१०.
The son of a deer, became the plaything of dance, song, etc.
2: Ib.

. १८.
Gave son चतुरङ्ग to लोम्पाद-Das4a- ratha.
3: M. ४८. ९६.
Blessed his son with a son;
4: वा. ९९. १०४.
one of the seven sages.
5: वा. १००. ११.
